name: claude route R16
claim: The Claude Code listener forwards only requests with the Claude Code shape on the unpublished listener; the published listener never forwards a client-supplied credential upstream. Measured so far, core only and no model, on head e97e47b: the shape check allows exactly the model of routes, methods and session-header on both listeners over 12000 seeded requests, 0 mismatches; a request or header list of the wrong shape gets 400 with no throw; the harness listener forwards an allowlist (content-type, accept, anthropic-version, its own x-api-key) and drops every other client header, cookie and proxy-authorization included, and fails closed without its own key; the Claude Code listener is a blind copy minus host and connection (1035091 checks, 0 failed, docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21-e97e47b.json). Still unmeasured: listener isolation, which needs the node listeners and a container network.

name: claude route R4
claim: A halt ends the stream within one further event for cuttable blocks, delivers partial blocks, and the consumer (page or Claude Code) proceeds with its next request without error. Design decision: on the Claude Code listener a halt waits for an open thinking or tool_use block, because cutting thinking breaks its signature (R17) and cutting tool_use breaks the call, so the budget is not a bound there (up to 39296 events on a 1 MB thinking stream); on the harness listener thinking is cut at once and tool_use waits. Measured so far, core only and no model, on head e97e47b: 86776 single-budget halt points over 12 synthetic streams (1 KB to 1 MB, 4 shapes), 2240 combined-budget trials, 72 corner budgets and 51 injected upstream errors, 0 failures in 1035091 checks; each halt is a well-formed ending, the delivered head is an exact original prefix, tool_use is never cut and thinking is never cut on the Claude Code listener (docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21-e97e47b.json). Still unmeasured: that Claude Code or the page accepts the ending and proceeds, which needs a real Claude Code and a key in a container.

means: Per-event stream function returning pass, halt or alter against a budget; ends one response stream. Unlike 'halt' (qofxtx), which stops every tab.
